firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently had a cup of coffee is the starting master and takes the master token.
clarifications: The master begins each round; after that round, the master token passes to the player on the left.
This answer uses the base-game setup, not the separate auction variant.

sources.title: Café — English rulebook
